736930101.text: How did this fall to me? Couldn't we have assigned this task to a more experienced senior student?

736930102.text: Hmm? Are you running some event here as well?

736930103.text: Eh!? Oh, Traveler, um... Yes, yes, we are indeed... running an event.

736930104.text: Well, I say it's an event, but really, it's... a Domain that awaits exploration.

736930105.text: Does this Domain have anything to do with the Gala?

736930106.text: *sigh* Oh, let's not even get into that. I only came to be in charge of this affair because of the Gala.

736930107.text: Sorry, I forgot to introduce myself. I'm Bahador from Spantamad, and our research lies in the field of alchemy, the elements, and topics like that...

736930108.text: So, I was assigned this task, but as much as I've thought about it, I couldn't think of a game that our Darshan could run.

736930109.text: Putting up a crafting bench to do public alchemical experiments would be too boring...

736930110.text: And there was no way we could run some demonstration of Elemental Reactions. If something went wrong, the whole site might go up in smoke — and what would we do then?

736930111.text: In the end, I had to ask the Adventurers' Guild for help, and it was with their aid that I found this Domain.

736930112.text: Several of my fellow students and I went inside to investigate, and to be honest, it is an utter mess in there.

736930113.text: As such, we developed a few potions specialized for use inside this Domain.

736930114.text: And well, that's our Darshan's specialty demonstrated now, eh? Hahaha...

736930115.text: So if you're interested, Traveler, take these potions with you and go investigate the Domain. I'll mark its location on your <color=#00E1FFFF>map</color>.

736930118.text: Q—Quite a few adventurers did come to give this a go! They were quite excited, too.

736930119.text: But I must say that very few of our fellow students did...

736930120.text: *sigh* Whatever the case may be, you can go in as long as you're interested.

736930121.text: The adventurers who tried this earlier rated it as being "very challenging."

736939901.text: (Luckily, I don't have to enter this Domain. I just need to keep watch outside...)
